Pregunté el tiempo que debía esperar y me informaron que una hora. Me quedé en el bar Full de la estación y puntualmente a la hora fui. elmuchacho que lava inmediatamente me recibió y entregó las llaves del auto, al que dejó IMPECABLE. Felicito el servicio ofrecito y al personal que alli trabaja y aun costo muy accesible !!!! Gracias por la atención !!!!

(Translated by Google)
I had the opportunity to take my car to be washed at the location on Oroño and 3 de Febrero streets. Having made an appointment, they received my vehicle quickly and very kindly from the women who assisted me. I asked how long I should expect to wait and they told me about an hour. I stayed at the Full bar at the gas station and arrived promptly at the appointed time. The young man who washes cars immediately greeted me and handed me the keys, leaving my car spotless. I commend the service offered and the staff who work there, and at a very affordable price! Thank you for your attention!
